svg.title: Jury convicts man of starting the fire that became the Palisades Fire
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. In a wood-panelled courtroom, a jury of twelve sits in its box at left, a judge in a black robe sits at the raised bench, and at right a man in a grey jacket stands under a spotlight between two attorneys at the defense table. The courtroom's back wall opens onto an illustrative night view of hillside homes above the ocean: beneath the slope, a thin glowing thread of embers creeps through tangled roots from a small spark to a wall of flame and smoke on the ridge, a diagram of the prosecution's account that a Jan. 1, 2025 fire smoldered underground before flaring into the Palisades Fire. Represents the Nov. 20, 2026 federal verdict convicting Jonathan Rinderknecht of starting the fire, which killed 12 people.
